interpretation.gain_sign: Positive gain favors the higher executed holding action.
interpretation.next_event: The endpoint is the actual next global control event and may differ across branches, including zero elapsed time.
interpretation.cost_300: Raw generalized passenger seconds over the same 300-second intervention-clock window; low cost minus high cost is the gain.
interpretation.scope: Two original development seeds, fixed lines and eligibility window. No branch outcome enters replay, policy, world, or trust training.
